name: Sites
description: Websites made elsewhere (Webmaster, any static site builder) published as records: one site_pages record per page (site, slug, title, html), owned by whoever published it, served at /s/{site} and /s/{site}/{page}. The HTML is the author's, so every page is served sandboxed (Content-Security-Policy: sandbox without allow-same-origin): its scripts run in an opaque origin and can never read this server's session cookie or call its API as the visitor. A page shows when it is public or the visitor owns it; nothing else is rendered. No front door in the nav (nav_optional): each published site is its own place, reached at /s/{site}.
